questions.question: Select the set of numbers that is similar to following set of numbers. (13, 40, 121)
questions.questionHtml:
Select the set of numbers that is similar to following set of numbers.

(13, 40, 121)
questions.solution:
The pattern followed is,

First number × 3 + 1 = Second number 

Second number × 3 + 1 = Third number

(13, 40, 121) ⇒

(13  × 3) +1 = 39 + 1 = 40

(40 × 3) + 1 = 120 + 1 = 121

Similarly,

Option 1: (5, 16, 49)

(5 × 3) +1 = 15 + 1 = 16

(16 × 3) + 1 = 48 + 1 = 49

This option follows the logic.

Option 2: (3, 12, 39)

(3 × 3) + 1 = 9 + 1 = 10 ≠ 12

(10 × 3) + 1 = 30 + 1 = 31 ≠ 39

Option 3: (7, 24, 73)

(7 × 3) + 1 = 21 + 1 = 22  ≠ 24

(22 × 3) + 1 = 66 + 1 = 67 ≠ 73

Option 4: (9, 28, 83)

(9 × 3) + 1 = 27 + 1 = 28 

(28 × 3) + 1 = 84 + 1 = 85 ≠ 83

(5, 16, 49) is similar to the given set of numbers.

Hence, (5, 16, 49) is the correct answer.

questions.question: Select the option in which the numbers share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of numbers. 6 ∶ 54
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option in which the numbers share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of numbers.

6 ∶ 54
questions.solution:
The logic is:

6 : 54 → 5 + 4 = 9 and 9 - 6 = 3

Similarly,

4 : 16 → 1 + 6 = 7 and 7 - 4 = 3

Hence, ‘4 : 16’ is the correct answer.

Alternate Method

Method 1:

6 ∶ 54 → 54 is completely divisible by 6

Similarly;

4 : 16 → 16 is completely divisible by 4.

Method 2:

The logic is:

(First Number ÷ 2)3 × 2 = Second Number

6 : 54 → 

(6 ÷ 2)3 × 2 = 33 × 2 = 27 × 2 = 54

Similarly,

4 : 16 → 

(4 ÷ 2)3 × 2 = 23 × 2 = 8 × 2 = 16

Hence, ‘4 : 16’ is the correct answer.

Method 3:

Second number  = (First number)3 ÷ 4

6 : 54 →

Second number = (6)3 ÷ 4 = 216 ÷ 4 = 54 

Similarly,

4 : 16 →

Second number = (4)3 ÷ 4 = 64 ÷ 4  = 16

Hence, the correct answer is "4 : 16".

= 36 ÷ 2 - 15 × 6 + 48

= 18 - 90 + 48 = -24 ≠ 14

2) 6 and 14

 36 ÷ 14 - 15 × 2 + 48 

= 2.571 - 30 + 48

= 20.57 ≠ 14

3) 36 and 48

 48 ÷ 6 - 15 × 2 + 36 

= 8 - 30 + 36 = 14

4) 48 and 15

= 36 ÷ 6 - 48 × 2 + 15

= 6 - 96 + 15 = -75 ≠ 14

Hence, the correct answer is 36 and 48.

In 18 : 333

Similarly,
